place.en: The bank of the Si River

setup.zh: 指尖触到的一瞬，银光灭了。掌心里躺着一只小铃——银的，湿冷，系绳早烂了。摇一摇，不响。
setup.en: The moment your fingers touch it, the silver light goes out. In your palm lies a small bell — silver, cold and wet, its cord long rotted. You shake it: no sound.

text.zh: 雨小了。河水从手边过去，像是什么刚刚走开。
text.en: The rain eases. The river runs past your hand as though something has just left.

exits.means: gives a name to be called by, or picks one of the offered names

text.en: {name}. From today, that is your name on the road.
